title: fr.node.hubs_set arguments
description: Set the board's hub list (design multi-hub-m1; 1.1). Applied about 300 ms after the RESULT. A list that names the hub the board is on is kept at once; any other is on trial until one of its hubs WELCOMEs the board, and dropped for the list it had when none does within 60 s. EXPIRED for a rev at or below the one held (the same list and rev again is OK), INVALID_ARGS for a host or ip that is not one or a host named twice, BUSY while an earlier list waits to apply, UNSUPPORTED on a board without a hub IP link (a gateway, a radio-off build).

hubs.description: in priority order, the first is the board's default hub; empty: no list, the board uses the hub it was provisioned with (<= 4 items)

rev.description: above the rev the board holds (hubs_get), so a stale push never wins
